tagline: Agent memory pipelines are in Beta.
what_it_does: Agent memory pipelines are in Beta. A memory pipeline connects a session store to a memory store. Each run uses an LLM to distill durable facts, preferences, and decisions from stored conversations into memory entries that your agent recalls in later conversations.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
